	, CASE 
		WHEN amount <> 0
			OR ori_amount <> 0
			OR org_amount <> 0
			OR group_amount <> 0
			OR control_amount <> 0
			OR global_amount <> 0
		THEN 1
		ELSE 0
	END AS is_not_all_zero
	, CASE 
		WHEN direction IS NULL
			OR direction = 'IN'
		THEN ori_amount
		ELSE 0
	END AS i_ori_amount
	, CASE 
		WHEN direction IS NULL
			OR direction = 'IN'
		THEN amount
		ELSE 0
	END AS i_amount
	, CASE 
		WHEN direction IS NULL
			OR direction = 'IN'
		THEN org_amount
		ELSE 0
	END AS i_org_amount
	, CASE 
		WHEN direction IS NULL
			OR direction = 'IN'
		THEN 0
		ELSE amount
	END AS o_amount
	, CASE 
		WHEN direction IS NULL
			OR direction = 'IN'
		THEN 0
		ELSE global_amount
	END AS o_global_amount
	, CASE 
		WHEN direction IS NULL
			OR direction = 'IN'
		THEN global_amount
		ELSE 0
	END AS i_global_amount
	, CASE 
		WHEN direction IS NULL
			OR direction = 'IN'
		THEN control_amount
		ELSE 0
	END AS i_control_amount
	, CASE 
		WHEN direction IS NULL
			OR direction = 'IN'
		THEN 0
		ELSE ori_amount
	END AS o_ori_amount
	, CASE 
		WHEN is_cash_flow_opening = '1' THEN 0
		ELSE bd_period_id
	END AS period_id
	, CASE 
		WHEN direction IS NULL
			OR direction = 'IN'
		THEN group_amount
		ELSE 0
	END AS i_group_amount
	, CASE 
		WHEN direction IS NULL
			OR direction = 'IN'
		THEN 0
		ELSE org_amount
	END AS o_org_amount
	, CASE 
		WHEN is_cash_flow_opening = '1' THEN concat(substr(voucher_record_id_period_code, 1, 5), '01')
		ELSE substr(voucher_record_id_period_code, 1, 7)
	END AS period_code
	, CASE 
		WHEN direction IS NULL
			OR direction = 'IN'
		THEN 0
		ELSE group_amount
	END AS o_group_amount
	, CASE 
		WHEN direction IS NULL
			OR direction = 'IN'
		THEN 0
		ELSE control_amount
	END AS o_control_amount
